items.title: Forget Tourbillons. Jacob & Co. Is Now Selling Caviar.
items.why: Ultra-high-end brands are stretching into food collabs, a signal for how affluent buyers are being courted beyond watches.
items.summary_ai: Jacob & Co. launched a caviar product with Icone Caviar, aged for months for added complexity.
items.take: Ultra-high-end brands are stretching into food collabs, a signal for how affluent buyers are being courted beyond watches.
